title: Log in to Blog Notes
description: As a registered blogger, I want to log in with my username and password, so that I can see and manage my own blog posts.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a registered user on the Login page, when they enter a valid username and password and click 'Log in', then they land on the 'My Blogs' page and see 'Welcome, <display name>'.
Given a registered user on the Login page, when they enter a wrong password and click 'Log in', then the message 'Invalid username or password' is shown and they stay on the Login page.
The Login page shows a Username field, a Password field and a 'Log in' button, as in the approved design.
